description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator class, which aggregates multiple authentication failure results into a single exception, particularly handling DittoRuntimeExceptions and related headers in a security/authentication context.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator, testing its behavior when aggregating authentication failures.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test instance before each test execution.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWithEmptyList
methods.description: Tests that aggregating an empty list of authentication results throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWithoutDittoRuntimeExceptions
methods.description: Verifies that non-DittoRuntimeException failures lead to an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWitNestedDittoRuntimeExceptionWithoutDescription
methods.description: Tests that nested DittoRuntimeExceptions without a description result in an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWitNestedDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Checks proper aggregation of nested DittoRuntimeExceptions with description, resulting in expected aggregated exception.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Validates correct aggregation of multiple failure results into a GatewayAuthenticationFailedException with combined headers and messages.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWithExceptionNotUnauthorized
methods.description: Ensures that when failures have different status codes, the one with a non-UNAUTHORIZED status is returned.
